messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Model rollout v1.2.3 canary failure rate spike detected (error-rate 8% -> 32%) across eu-west-1 canary pool. Pager triggered.
oncall-alex: ack — I'm looking. Paging in @sre-jen and @ml-ops-raj.
sre-jen: on it. grabbing logs and initial metrics. any customer reports yet?
cs-miguel: we have 3 customer-reported degraded responses in the last 15m (support tickets linked). severity: medium.
ml-ops-raj: quick note: this rollout swapped quantized kernels for q4_0 on the canary. suspecting inference failures tied to kernel change.
oncall-alex: timeline pls — when did canary start receiving traffic and what %?
sre-jen: canary traffic started 2974998600 (~43m ago). initial traffic 2% routed, increased to 10% at 2974999800. spike starts at ~2975000700.
sre-jen: sharing logs excerpt:
```
2026-03-17T12:24:56Z model-server[canary]: WARN decode_failures=12 request_id=... seq_len=64
2026-03-17T12:25:12Z model-server[canary]: ERROR kv_cache_miss backend_err=OOM path=/tmp/kv_cache
2026-03-17T12:25:43Z model-server[canary]: ERROR tokenization_mismatch inputs=2/128
```
ml-ops-raj: hypothesis A: q4_0 kernel produces KV cache growth -> OOMs causing retries/failures. Hypothesis B: the model conversion step missed a padding check leading to tokenization mismatches.
product-emma: customer impact: some latency spikes and truncated responses; a few customers see completions cut off. prioritize rollback if impact widens.
oncall-alex: can we reproduce on a canary node locally? @raj?
ml-ops-raj: spinning a local replica with v1.2.3 + q4_0 now. trying to replay failing request from logs.
sre-jen: while that's running, suggestion: reduce canary traffic to 0% and pin serving to v1.2.1 in eu-west-1 to stop customer hits. anyone opposed?
ml-ops-raj: +1 for immediate pin. will lose some signal but prevents escalation.
oncall-alex: do it. @sre-jen please execute pin and confirm when complete.
sre-jen: executed route pin: set model:v1.2.1 -> 100% for eu-west-1 canary pool at 2975001320. rolling back canary traffic now.
incident-bot: Action logged: route pin performed by sre-jen at 2975001320. previous routes backed up as route-backup-2975001319.
cs-miguel: confirming support tickets — degradations stopped after ~2975001400. I'll update customers.
ml-ops-raj: local replay shows tokenization mismatch when using the new converter flags used in v1.2.3. reproduces deterministic failure: `tokenizer.encode()` returns shorter arrays for some inputs.
oncall-alex: good repro. next steps: 1) keep v1.2.1 pinned, 2) collect full canary node logs + converter diff, 3) rollback candidate if fix not immediate, 4) start RCA doc.
product-emma: I'll open an RCA doc and add the customer impact summary and action items. tagging engineering leads.
sre-jen: uploading full logs to /shared/incidents/2975001234/logs.tar.gz and adding timeline events.
ml-ops-raj: action: revert converter flags and rebuild v1.2.3-candidate then run canary QA. ETA ~2h.
oncall-alex: if candidate not ready in 2h, we'll keep pin and schedule outage window for safe rollback if needed. any blocking onensics requests?
cs-miguel: please include per-customer request ids for the three reported customers so I can correlate.
ml-ops-raj: noted, attaching ids in RCA doc.
sre-jen: end state: traffic pinned at 100% to v1.2.1 in eu-west-1, no broader rollback. monitoring for residual errors. next update in 30m unless things change. :white_check_mark:
